Card Q&A.q: If I have another Digimon in play, can I choose any one of this card's three effects?

Card Q&A.a: The owner of the card gets to decide the order they activate in.
Card Q&A.q: If I don't have another Digimon in play, what order do I activate this card's three effects in?

Effect: [When Attacking] Activate 1 of the effects below. If you have no other Digimon in play, activate all of the effects below instead.
・This Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.
・Delete up to 3 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon.
